item.title: Nikion #5172 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos).
item.description: Nikion #5172 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Ikarmedes #3949 the Hollow was broken and is whole again (3×). The House of Udaeus made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.description: Doreia #2032 and Sosides #9960 fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget. Doreia's name is known across the archipelago.

item.description: Thephon #4142 and Kratphon #4205 fell in love in the Field of Ares. The House of Udaeus pretend not to notice.
